_about: Synthetic company directory for the Enricher (D-6). Every company, domain, number and description here is invented; domains are RFC 2606 reserved names. The Enricher reads this file and nothing else: no web lookup in this build. `kind` is what the Qualifier uses to tell a buyer from a vendor or a school; `aliases` are the spellings a lead might type.
